transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Hello, this is calling from our company. Is this a good time to talk about your account?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.message: Hi, yes, this is Chloe. I've been expecting your call—apologies for the late payment. I had an unexpected car repair that threw off my budget, but I really want to get this sorted. Is now a good time to discuss setting up a payment plan?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message:
Hi Chloe, thanks so much for picking up—and for being proactive about this. I really appreciate you taking the time to talk. And yes, now is absolutely fine. Do you have a quiet moment where you can speak freely? I want to make sure you feel comfortable.

First, thank you for sharing what happened. Car repairs can come out of nowhere and really throw things off—that’s completely understandable. I’m here to help, not to add stress, so let’s work together to find a plan that fits your situation right now.

You mentioned wanting to set up a payment plan—that’s a great step. To help me tailor something realistic, would you be comfortable sharing what kind of monthly amount you think you could manage moving forward? Even if it’s smaller, we can build a plan that works for you.
